candidate.explanation_ar: بتيجي بمعنى 'لكن' أو 'مع ذلك' عشان تربط جملتين فيهم تناقض.

senses.definition_en: Used to connect two contrasting statements, qualities, or ideas; but or nevertheless.
senses.explanation_ar: تُستخدم للربط بين أمرين متناقضين بمعنى 'لكن' أو 'مع ذلك'.
examples: The path was dark, yet I found my way.
He has a good job, and yet he never seems to have any money.
